watches.name: Tourbillon Royal Blue
watches.description: Ref. 424211010 Blue. Gold. Limited Edition of 5 pieces Speake Marin unveils the Tourbillon Royal Blue, a refined expression of British elegance and traditional Swiss watchmaking. Housed in the Maison’s iconic 42 mm Piccadilly case in 5N red gold, it pays tribute to the English heritage of its founder while reflecting the distinctive vision shaped by Christelle Rosnoblet, CEO & Owner. Its openworked architecture is enhanced by Royal Blue, Speake Marin’s signature shade inspired by Pantone 287 C. Deep blue tones contrast beautifully with the warmth of red gold, revealing the depth and complexity of the movement. Visible through the sapphire caseback, the in-house automatic calibre SMA05 combines a fully integrated micro-rotor with a flying tourbillon. Completed by a Royal Blue ostrich strap, this exceptional creation is limited to just five pieces worldwide.

watches.name: Minute Repeater Carillon
watches.description: Ref. 964282400 Time, made audible. Some hours are read. This one is heard. The Minute Repeater Carillon is the very first chiming watch to emerge from Le Cercle des Horlogers, our manufacture; a unique piece that gives Speake Marin's iconic Piccadilly case a voice of its own. At a touch, hours, quarters and minutes ring out across three gongs, a miniature carillon composed in titanium and platinum. Beneath the openworked dial, the signature red XII seems to collapse into the architecture of the movement, hand-painted, suspended over a flying tourbillon turning quietly at 6 o'clock. It is the maison's British soul at its most eloquent: understated on the wrist, unforgettable in the ear. Look closer. The 42 mm Piccadilly case pairs a grade 5 titanium side case in grey PVD with a platinum bezel and caseback, chosen for the purity of its resonance. At its heart beats the Calibre SMA-HH02, 536 components, 51 jewels and a 60-second flying tourbillon, hand-wound with a 72-hour power reserve. Every surface tells of the bench: hand-polished bevelled cage bridges with drawn flanks, a diamond-bevelled balance wheel plated in 3N gold, heart-shaped blued hands gliding above Côtes de Genève. The art of time, struck in sound.

watches.name: Resilience Midnight Titanium
watches.description: Ref. 413802610 & 414202610 SpeakEasy Collection - Aventurine. Craft. Equinox. In seventeenth-century Venice, a Murano glassmaker let iron filings fall into molten glass, alla ventura, and a constellation was born. Four centuries later, Speake Marin captures that happy accident at the heart of the Resilience Midnight. Its mirror-polished aventurine dial holds a fragment of the night sky, each disc a unique microcosm of stars, deep blue and quietly luminous. Look closer. Each dial begins as a block of aventurine glass, selected for its colour, translucency and natural shimmer, then cut into fine discs with diamond saws and polished in three successive stages to reach flawless brilliance and exact thickness. Elongated Roman numerals in brilliant white bring a touch of classicism, while the heart-shaped hour hand and double-leaf minute hand pay homage to the clock of London's Elizabeth Tower, a nod to the maison's British heritage. The chemin de fer minute track pauses at 1:30 for the small seconds counter, the signature of the house. To wear the Resilience Midnight is to carry the interplay of chance, artisanal mastery and celestial wonder on the wrist.

specsRaw.Water-resistance: 3 ATM Dial Blue aventurine glass dial with a starry-sky effect.

watches.name: Portobello
watches.description: Ref. 604015600 Arty. Vibrant. Lavender Crafted in stainless steel, its distinctive “La City” case recalls the geometry of London’s financial district: a square bezel softened by rounded lines, polished contours meeting satin-finished surfaces in a subtle dialogue of structure, light and proportion. Look closer. The sculpted lavender dial, adorned with twelve three-dimensional horizontal ripples and satin-finished entirely by hand, draws its inspiration from the vibrant façades of Portobello, one of London’s most distinctive and colourful neighbourhoods. Its lavender shade evokes the pastel townhouses that give the district its singular charm; expressive, elegant and gently unconventional. This play on colour extends to the strap, whose yellow inner lining offers a discreet yet luminous contrast, inspired by the bright yellow façade standing beside the lavender house that sparked the creation. A hidden detail, conceived as a subtle nod to Portobello’s free-spirited and vibrant character. The Ripples Portobello Lavender. London spirit, Swiss precision.

watches.name: Resilience Black Allumettes
watches.description: Ref. 124202180 From the Maison's Own Archive Certain pieces never leave a maison's hands through ordinary channels. This Resilience "Black Allumettes" is offered exclusively through the Speake Marin online boutique as part of a programme entirely controlled by the maison — not a resale platform, not a marketplace, but a deliberate act of curation. It will not be found elsewhere. Speake Marin occasionally releases exceptional pieces from its own heritage: watches conceived during the founding era of Peter Speake-Marin, produced in very limited numbers, and rarely made available to the wider public. Selected for their historical significance, rarity, or enduring character, these timepieces are offered a second chapter with collectors who will fully appreciate them. Before being presented, each watch is carefully inspected and certified by the manufacture team of Le Cercle des Horlogers in La Chaux-de-Fonds. This piece has been fully inspected and certified by Speake Marin's own team. It is presented in excellent condition, accompanied by its original documentation.

watches.name: Magister Diamond Tourbillon
watches.description: Ref. 10030 Gold. Tourbillon. Mastery. The Magister Tourbillon, in 5N red gold and diamonds, brings together everything that is quintessentially Speake-Marin: an eye-catching tourbillon, sculpted heat-blued hands, the iconic Piccadilly case, fluted crown, and a finely finished movement, here featuring a platinum micro-rotor. Look closer. The hand-finished tourbillon at 6 o'clock reveals a highly polished bridge crafted from Durnico maraging steel, chosen for its superior strength. The Speake-Marin topping tool wheel motif resurfaces in the design of the tourbillon cage itself, a quiet signature woven into the most technical element of the watch. While the tourbillon is renowned for its capacity to improve timekeeping accuracy, it is above all the visual beauty of this mesmerising escapement that captivates: its one-minute rotation brings the dial to life with a subtle sense of animation. The sculpted blued-steel hands are set off superbly by the pristine white lacquer, multi-level dial, contrasting neatly with the warm hue of the regal red gold case. The dial is framed beautifully by the polished red gold bezel, just as the tourbillon is framed by the polished stainless steel guard around the escapement. Through the display back, the hand-finished calibre reveals itself in full: atop the offset mainspring barrel sits the noble platinum micro-rotor, its sober aesthetic counterbalanced by the intricate complexity of the tourbillon. The Magister Tourbillon. Gold and diamonds, perfected.

watches.name: Kármán Line
watches.description: Ref. 604020010 Blue Sapphire. Thickness. Precision. The Ripples Kármán Line brings together everything that defines Speake Marin at its most technically ambitious: a sapphire crystal dial with blue metallisation, the iconic small seconds at 1:30, and the ultra-thin La City case in 904L stainless steel. Look closer. The dial is not a surface, it is a statement. Crafted from sapphire crystal glass, its blue metallisation shifts with the light, its reverse side adorned with a sunray finish and Côtes de Genève motif that reveal themselves like a sky seen from altitude. The heart-shaped hour hand moves across rhodium-plated baton indices with quiet authority, while the minute flange, in blue PVD with an opal microbeaded finish, traces the outer limit of the dial like the boundary it is named after: the invisible threshold where Earth's atmosphere gives way to space, 100 kilometres above the surface. Beneath the sapphire crystal, the in-house SMA06 calibre beats at 5Hz, its 175 components held within a movement just 2.5mm thin. The tungsten micro-rotor, decorated with an exclusive pattern of raised and recessed rectangles in alternating rhodium and blue PVD, is as quietly spectacular as the dial it serves. At 6.30mm thick, the 40.30mm La City case barely registers on the wrist. The integrated 904L steel bracelet, with micro-adjustment to the millimetre, completes a watch that leaves nothing unconsidered. The Ripples Kármán Line. Where watchmaking meets the edge of everything.

watches.name: Koala
watches.description: Ref. 413817420 & 414217420 Hand-painted. Artistry. Nature. Through its Koala Art Series timepiece, Speake Marin brings together artistic craftsmanship and meaningful commitment, proudly supporting Queensland Koala Crusaders and the preservation of one of Australia's most precious icons. The new generation Piccadilly case, crafted in Grade 5 titanium, carries the spirit of this commitment with quiet strength. Sapphire crystals, front and back, treated with anti-reflective coating, frame a canvas where art and conservation meet. Look closer. The dial, hand-finished through micro painting with a rotating topping tool, unfolds in a graduated green lacquer, light Pantone 2276C melting into deeper Pantone 3508C, evoking eucalyptus canopies and the quiet wilderness this piece was born to protect. Central hours and minutes sit alongside a small seconds at 1:30, the Maison's signature gesture, reinforcing its singular identity. The in-house SMA03 calibre, with fully integrated micro-rotor, beats beneath with discreet precision. A bracelet in green recycled PET nylon, lined in corn-based leather, completes the piece with the same conscience that inspired it. This is independent watchmaking at its most purposeful. Art on the wrist. Advocacy at heart. Limited to 3 pieces in 38mm and 6 pieces in 42mm, the rare expression of a Maison that believes craftsmanship can carry a cause. The Koala Art Series. Where beauty serves a greater purpose.

watches.name: Rhinoceros
watches.description: Ref. 413813360 Engraved. Wild. Devoted. Speake Marin developed a limited edition of 9 pieces in partnership with Save the Rhino International, combining exceptional craftsmanship with a meaningful commitment to wildlife preservation. The iconic Piccadilly case, crafted in Grade 5 titanium, carries this commitment with quiet gravity. Sapphire crystals, front and back, treated with anti-reflective coating, frame a dial born entirely of the hand. Look closer. Engraved by hand on a black glossy lacquer, the rhinoceros emerges through the rotating topping tool technique, a craft demanding patience, precision, and an artisan's intimate knowledge of texture and depth. Heart-shaped rhodium-plated hands, the Maison's signature gesture, sweep across central hours and minutes, with the small seconds settling at 1:30. Beneath, the in-house SMA03 calibre with micro-rotor offers 52 hours of power reserve, water-resistant to 3 ATM. A bracelet in lime tree wood, lined in natural cork, completes the piece, material chosen not for convention, but for conscience. This is haute horlogerie in service of the wild. Nine pieces. One cause. The rare achievement of a Maison that understands craftsmanship as a form of advocacy. The Rhinoceros. Engraved by hand, for a future worth protecting.

watches.name: Tourbillon Purple Hour
watches.description: Ref. 913811570 Purple. Tourbillon. British Twist. At its heart, the flying tourbillon appears to float effortlessly, animating the dial with rhythm and depth while showcasing the Maison's dedication to fine Swiss craftsmanship and mechanical artistry. The Piccadilly case, in polished-brushed Grade 5 titanium, frames this performance with quiet confidence. The 3D dial, finished in a striking purple PVD coating, is specially shaped to make room for the mechanical architecture beneath — its bevelled edges shining bright against satin-microbeaded pockets, a contrast achieved only through patient hand-finishing. Look closer. At 1:30, the flying tourbillon cage, its bridge shaped like a topping tool, rhodium-plated, mirror-polished, bevelled along every profile, turns with hypnotic precision. The barrel, engraved with the inscription marking this openworked creation, sits at 10:00 as a quiet signature of intent. Luminescent heart-shaped hands, the Maison's unmistakable mark, glow blue against grey lacquer, while the purple minute flange comes alive after dark. Beneath, the in-house SMA05 calibre, 290 components hand-assembled into a sixty-second flying tourbillon, delivers 72 hours of power reserve at 21,600 vibrations per hour, a tungsten micro-rotor turning with laser-engraved precision at its centre. This is independent watchmaking at its most luminous. Suspended. Glowing. The rare confidence of a Maison that lets mechanical artistry speak for itself, even after the lights go down. The Tourbillon Purple Hour. Time, illuminated.

watches.name: Dual Time Terracotta
watches.description: Ref. 413809020 Terracotta. Travel. Two Horizons. The Openworked Dual Time Terracotta by Speake-Marin captures the spirit of travel through colour, light and mechanical sophistication. Inspired by the warm terracotta tones of the legendary Roland-Garros clay courts, that particular shade of earth, sun-baked and unmistakably French, that has coloured a century of summer afternoons, this contemporary timepiece blends effortless elegance with bold architectural watchmaking. The Piccadilly case, in polished-brushed Grade 5 titanium, frames this vivid inspiration with quiet structure. Its vibrant openworked dial, paired with a refined green leather strap, creates a striking harmony between urban chic and sporting refinement. Look closer. The frosted, hand-finished dial plate, coated in terracotta-orange PVD, reveals rhodium-plated, micro-blasted skeletonised bridges, their mirror-polished bevels catching light like the chalked lines of a court at dusk. At 9:00, a two-tone day/night second time zone unfolds in Arabic numerals, glowing orange against matte grey Super-LumiNova for those whose days stretch across more than one horizon. At 1:30, the small seconds and retrograde date settle into the composition with the Maison's signature precision. Rooted in colour, free in spirit. An inspiration from elsewhere, carried by the call of travel. The Dual Time Terracotta. Time, in motion.

watches.name: Dual Time Pink
watches.description: Ref. 413809430 Pink. Travel. Dual Time. The One & Two Openworked Collection pursues its dream of travel and evasion with its timepiece: the Dual Time Pink. The new generation Piccadilly case, in black DLC-coated Grade 5 titanium, frames this vivid declaration with quiet contrast. Sapphire crystals, front and back, treated with anti-reflective coating, hold a dial unlike any restraint the Maison has shown before. Look closer. The openworked dial unfolds in a striking Pantone 700C pink against a black matte finish, bold, unapologetic, alive. At 9 o'clock, the 24-hour Home Time indication, rendered in black and pink, anchors the piece's purpose: a watch built for those who carry two horizons at once. Heart-shaped hands, lacquered in the same vivid pink, sweep across hours, minutes, and seconds, while a retrograde date and small seconds settle at 1:30 with the Maison's signature precision. Beneath, the in-house SMA02 calibre with fully integrated micro-rotor beats with quiet discipline beneath all that colour. A pink rubber strap with black DLC titanium buckle, or a red textile strap in recycled PET, completes the piece, vivid choices for a vivid spirit. This is independent watchmaking with nowhere to hide. Bold in colour. Precise in purpose. Limited to 10 pieces in 38mm and 28 pieces in 42mm, the rare expression of a Maison that believes travel should never be timid. The Dual Time Pink. Two times, one statement.

watches.description: Ref. 423817440 & 424217440 Gold. Texture. Openworked. The Sandblasted Red Gold by Speake Marin reveals a bold interpretation of contemporary haute horlogerie, where architectural design meets exceptional Swiss craftsmanship. Crafted in precious 18K red gold, this refined timepiece captivates through its sandblasted openworked dial, whose textured surfaces and sculptural depth create a striking interplay of light and shadow. Look closer. At the heart of the watch, the in-house SMA01 micro-rotor calibre unveils the beauty of fine watchmaking mechanics through a sophisticated multi-layered architecture. The visible barrel, engraved with Speake-Marin's values, sits as a quiet manifesto at the centre of the movement. The three-dimensional small seconds display at 1:30, and the Maison's signature heart-shaped hands, reinforce its unmistakable identity. This is independent watchmaking at its most textured. Raw where others polish. Honest where others conceal. The rare confidence of a Maison that lets the material speak before the metal ever shines. The Sandblasted Red Gold. Pure in form, frosted with light.

Sapphire crystals, front and back, treated with anti-reflective coating, frame a dial defined by texture rather than shine. Look closer. The sandblasted, skeletonised dial reveals Speake-Marin's engraved values on the visible barrel, a quiet manifesto sitting in plain sight at the heart of the movement. The small seconds counter at 1:30, applied in three dimensions, asserts its presence with architectural confidence, while polished heart-shaped hands, treated in black PVD, sweep across the dial with the Maison's unmistakable signature. watches.name: Resilience Gold
watches.description: Ref. 423802000 Enamel. Fire. Devotion. The Resilience model returns with its enchanting enamel dial, now enhanced with refined aesthetic and mechanical updates. Resilience Gold is born. The new generation Piccadilly case, in 18k 5N red gold, carries this rebirth with quiet warmth. Front and back sapphire crystals, treated with anti-reflective coating, frame a dial born of fire and patience. Look closer. Five layers of white Grand Feu enamel, fired and polished by hand, give the dial its luminous, almost liquid depth, a technique as demanding today as it has ever been. Oversized Roman numerals in glossy black, a blue minute flange, and heart-shaped hands polished and blued by hand bring quiet colour and signature elegance to the composition. Beneath, the in-house SMA03 calibre, with fully integrated tungsten micro-rotor, unfolds across 147 hand-finished components, bevelled and adorned with Côtes de Genève. A taupe ostrich leather strap, tone-on-tone stitched, completes the piece with quiet refinement. This is independent watchmaking at its most enduring. Fired by hand. Tempered by time. The Resilience Gold. Born again, in enamel and gold.

watches.name: Skeleton
watches.description: Ref. 604020150 Transparency. Thinness. Precision. The Ripples Skeleton is watchmaking laid bare. The iconic "La City" case in 904L stainless steel achieves something remarkable, a thickness of just 6.30 mm for a 40.30 mm diameter, a proportion that speaks of extraordinary engineering restraint. Every edge of the polished bezel, every satin-finished surface, carries the deliberate signature of a Maison that understands thinness as the ultimate expression of mastery. Look closer. Inside, the in-house SMA07 calibre unfolds across just 3.25 mm of movement thickness, a feat of miniaturised architecture housing 182 hand-finished components. The rhodium-plated bridges, bevelled and vertically satin-finished, are works of applied precision. The tungsten micro-rotor, bearing the Maison's exclusive embossed motif, oscillates at 36,000 vibrations per hour with a stillness that belies its complexity. This is independent watchmaking at its most considered. Slender. Intentional. The rare discipline of a Maison that understands that true luxury lives in what the eye can barely measure. The Ripples Skeleton. Mechanics, made precious.

watches.name: Infinity Date
watches.description: Ref. 604018440 Sport. Chic. Date. The Ripples Infinity Date is Speake Marin's purest expression of sport-chic. A timepiece that moves between worlds with the same effortless confidence it brings to every wrist. The "La City" case, in stainless steel, carries this versatility with quiet precision. Its square bezel, softened by rounded shapes and finished with a polished profile against satin-brushed surfaces, sets the tone: structured, but never rigid. Look closer. The metallic silver-white dial, rhodium-plated and sunray-finished, unfolds with quiet luminosity. Polished rhodium-plated hands, their heart-shaped hour tip an unmistakable signature, sweep across a white-silver minute track punctuated by sharp black dots. At 6 o'clock, the date window settles into a shot-blasted rectangular frame; discreet, deliberate, never an afterthought. Beneath, the in-house SMA03-TD calibre, 162 components hand-finished with bevelled bridges and Côtes de Genève, delivers 52 hours of power reserve at 28,800 vibrations per hour. A three-row integrated bracelet, polished and brushed in steel, completes the piece with the same fluid elegance. The Ripples Infinity Date. One watch. Every moment.

watches.name: Dune Date
watches.description: Ref. 604018120 Sand. Date. Limited. A contemporary expression of Speake Marin's sport-chic identity, the Ripples Dune Date combines architectural precision with refined versatility. Crafted in stainless steel, its distinctive "La City" case echoes London's financial district, a square bezel softened by rounded shapes, polished profile meeting satin-finished surface in quiet structural dialogue. Look closer. The sculpted dial, adorned with twelve three-dimensional horizontal ripples, satin-finished entirely by hand, plays with light and shadow in a tone inspired by desert sand. Polished rhodium-plated hands, their heart-shaped hour tip an unmistakable signature, sweep above a green small seconds counter with sunray finish, a quiet flash of colour against the dune-toned dial. At 6 o'clock, the date window settles within a rhodium-plated frame, shot-blasted on its sides and polished on top, precision rendered even in the smallest detail. Beneath, the in-house SMA03-TD calibre, 162 hand-finished components with bevelled, Côtes de Genève bridges, delivers 52 hours of power reserve — its tungsten micro-rotor bearing an exclusive engraved pattern, visible only to those who look twice. Limited to 60 pieces, this edition captures a sense of quiet boldness: structured, modern, and subtly artful. The Ripples Dune Date. Desert tones, Swiss precision.

watches.description: Ref. 604015040 Sport. Chic. Character. The Ripples Black Original by Speake-Marin is one of the latter. Born from the creative vision of Christelle Rosnoblet and designer Stéphane Lacroix, it carries on its dial the signature ripple motif, a quiet, almost meditative pattern that speaks of depth rather than spectacle. The "La City" case, in stainless steel, leads the way in Speake-Marin's sport-chic identity — a reflection of our times and of high watchmaking, discreet yet complex, adorning the wrist with effortless comfort. Front and back sapphire crystals, treated with anti-reflective coating, frame a dial built to be read at a glance and admired on second look. Look closer. The black dial, finished with the Maison's signature ripple texture, meets polished indexes with quiet precision. At 1:30, a black small seconds counter settles into the composition with characteristic restraint, while heart-shaped rhodium-plated hands — the Maison's unmistakable signature, sweep across central hours and minutes. Beneath, the in-house SMA03-T calibre, with fully integrated micro-rotor, reveals hand-finished bridges, inner angles, and Geneva stripes through its slender 9.20mm profile. An integrated stainless steel bracelet, secured by a steel folding buckle, completes the piece with the same fluid discipline. The Ripples Black Original. Modern English elegance, defined.
